sources.name: Open-Meteo Ensemble API — NOAA GEFS 0.25 deg (31 members)
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo); NOAA NCEP GEFS public domain
sources.descriptor: 31-member global ensemble forecast (ncep_gefs025) at 0.25 deg, hourly out to 7 days.

sources.name: Open-Meteo Ensemble API — ECMWF IFS 0.25 deg (51 members)
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo and ECMWF open data)
sources.descriptor: 51-member global ensemble forecast (ecmwf_ifs025) at 0.25 deg, hourly out to 7 days.

sources.name: Computed sun and moon ephemeris (Meeus / Astronomical Almanac low-precision terms)
sources.descriptor: Deterministic solar twilight, moonrise/moonset, lunar disc illumination and low-light dark minutes.

sources.name: NOAA Aviation Weather Center data API: METAR reports
sources.publisher: NOAA National Weather Service, Aviation Weather Center
sources.descriptor: Station observations used to score Vis's forecasts (plan step W3); stored append-only in history/metar.

sources.name: NASA Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS) WMTS, EPSG:3857
sources.licence: NASA data CC0; acknowledgement requested (data use guidance, read 22 Nov 2026)
sources.descriptor: Weather map tiles shown in the viewer's browser: GOES-East, GOES-West and Himawari imagery, GPM IMERG precipitation and GOES GLM lightning. Not ingested or scored.

sources.name: EUMETSAT EUMETView WMS (Meteosat MTG 0 deg, MSG 0 deg and MSG Indian Ocean)
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0, 'Contains modified EUMETSAT Meteosat data <year>' (EUMETSAT data policy as reported by the WMS capabilities and developer write-ups, 22 Nov 2026; to be checked against the policy text)
sources.descriptor: Weather map tiles shown in the viewer's browser: Meteosat infrared, water vapour, air mass and GeoColor imagery and MTG Lightning Imager flash area, covering Europe, Africa, the Middle East and South Asia, with H SAF rain rate, rapidly developing thunderstorm cells, and dust and fog RGBs. Not ingested or scored.

sources.name: Natural Earth 1:110m land and 1:50m land borders
sources.descriptor: Coastlines and borders on the weather map (site/geo/outlines.json, built by tools/outlines.py).

sources.name: RainViewer Weather Maps API (radar mosaic)
sources.licence: Free tier 'for personal and educational use only' (api.html, read 22 Nov 2026); attribution with a link required
sources.descriptor: Global radar tiles, past 2 hours at 10-minute steps, zoom 7 at most. Left out until it is clear whether Vis's use fits its terms or RainViewer agrees.

sources.name: NOAA NCEP opengeo GeoServer WMS: MRMS base reflectivity mosaics
sources.licence: US government work, public domain (NWS disclaimer, weather.gov/disclaimer, read 22 Nov 2026); no endorsement implied
sources.descriptor: Weather map radar tiles shown in the viewer's browser: lower 48, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico and Guam, about every 2 minutes. Not ingested or scored.

sources.name: Environment and Climate Change Canada MSC GeoMet WMS: radar composite and lightning density
sources.licence: ECCC Data Server End-use Licence: free use including commercial, credited 'Data Source: Environment and Climate Change Canada' (read 22 Nov 2026)
sources.descriptor: Weather map tiles shown in the viewer's browser: Canada's radar rain and snow rates every 6 minutes and lightning flash density every 10 minutes. Not ingested or scored.

sources.name: NOAA GFS 1-degree GRIB2 through the NOMADS grib filter
sources.descriptor: 250 hPa winds (jet stream streaks) and surface snow depth for the weather map, from the newest run at the build. Model values, not observations; not scored.

sources.name: NOAA Storm Prediction Center preliminary local storm reports (hail CSV)
sources.descriptor: US hail reports for today's and yesterday's convective days, drawn as points on the weather map. Preliminary and unverified; not scored.

sources.name: NOAA NESDIS Hazard Mapping System smoke polygons (KML)
sources.descriptor: Analysts' daily smoke analysis over North America (light, medium, heavy), drawn on the weather map. Not scored.
